pending_operations.title: Forgedeep Economic Return — Evidence and Decisions

suppressed_contexts: travel before physical arrival at Forgedeep

pending_operations.boot_trigger: silently check the activation gate at Arik session boot; show nothing unless played canonical text already establishes Arik physically landed in Forgedeep
pending_operations.play_trigger: activate exactly once when played canonical text establishes that Arik has physically landed in Forgedeep; do not activate in Avernus, at the Black Sluice, in Tethford, or during travel
pending_operations.current_boundary: Arik remains on the played departure path from Avernus through the Black Sluice, with other written tasks and travel still controlling; the operation is dormant and invisible until physical landing in Forgedeep is established in played canon
activation_guards: Do not surface, brief, activate, or execute this operation while Arik remains in Avernus, at the Black Sluice, in Tethford, or in travel before Forgedeep.
A mention of Forgedeep, an intention to travel there, a departure, a portal crossing, an approach, or an expected arrival does not satisfy the gate.
Only played canonical text establishing that Arik has physically landed in Forgedeep satisfies the activation gate.
Activate at most one runtime instance for this operation_id; repeated boots or duplicate evidence must reuse it rather than create another.
Activation surfaces unresolved fact requests and player-held decisions; it does not answer, roll, execute, or resolve any of them.
Do not advance campaign time merely by booting or reading this operation.
Establish the played surface arrival date before selecting any dated economic authority band or applying the approximately 27:1 dilation.
Treat every simulator value marked scenario_assumption as unknown in canon until evidence or a player ruling replaces it.
Collect existing records without a roll; roll only at an actual uncertain execution gate.
Do not post a ledger entry, change a Registry row, or write a Notion fact as canon without the applicable approval gate.
Re-check the Tinderbox Atlas at activation; keep GM-only fuses out of the player briefing.

delegation: Vara may collect records, run ordinary operations, sign existing-line contracts below 10,000 gp, and make ordinary hires or supplier substitutions.

Vara may recommend 10,000–50,000 gp commitments, pricing changes, new suppliers, and reallocations up to 10 percent; explicit confirmation is required where the standing doctrine marks them conditional.
The player decides commitments above 50,000 gp, new business lines, market entry, investments above 100,000 gp, executives, political policy, sovereign fiscal rules, and any canon promotion.

required_fact_requests.location: Avernus and the Black Sluice route to Forgedeep
required_fact_requests.due: before any dated economic record is admitted at Forgedeep
required_fact_requests.question: What are the played Avernus departure, Material crossing, and physical Forgedeep landing times?
required_fact_requests.evidence: session chronology plus the established dilation rule applied only after both endpoints exist
required_fact_requests.resolves: which current-actual, forward, or later economic records are admissible

required_fact_requests.owner: Vara's civic clerks and the City Council
required_fact_requests.question: What is the current civilian population by quarter, household type, occupation, and dependants, separately from every garrison count?
required_fact_requests.evidence: current census roll, ration issue roll, occupied housing roll, payroll headcount, and gate entries reconciled
required_fact_requests.resolves: the stale 450 snapshot, the staged 1,400–1,600 band, the false 8,000 simulator population, labour supply, and household demand

required_fact_requests.owner: Forgedeep City Development and Baen Real Estate
required_fact_requests.question: How many finished, occupied, vacant, and blocked dwelling spaces exist by quarter, and what are the current water, air, sanitation, clinic, school, market, and food-storage capacities?
required_fact_requests.evidence: completion certificates, occupancy register, utility capacity logs, service rosters, and storage ledgers
required_fact_requests.resolves: whether population growth is physically supportable and where the actual bottleneck lies

required_fact_requests.owner: Ilse Cramm with each operating manager
required_fact_requests.question: What did each active Forgedeep enterprise actually produce, consume, sell, hold, and lose in each of the last three closed months?
required_fact_requests.evidence: production journals, warehouse counts, invoices, payrolls, work-in-progress ledgers, and rejected-output logs
required_fact_requests.resolves: the 120-versus-180-ton Silversheen conflict, invented recipes, missing opening inventory, enterprise shortages, and the sixteen-of-ninety coverage gap

required_fact_requests.location: Neverwinter, Waterdeep, Forgedeep, and the Long Road corridor
required_fact_requests.owner: Hunding transport office and Arterial Road Network
required_fact_requests.due: before committing any procurement or redistribution plan
required_fact_requests.question: What are the actual travel days, monthly throughput, carrier rates, tolls, seasonal loss, and currently available capacity by road, ship, canal, and deep-road mode?
required_fact_requests.evidence: dispatch books, toll records, carrier manifests, arrival receipts, and the current route calendar

required_fact_requests.owner: Vara's treasury office and City Council

required_fact_requests.resolves: invented gross-revenue rates, unaged arrears, and the treasury and church monetary sinks
